verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a cloud invoicing SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions data centers, region selection, or residency controls. The security claims (PCI-DSS, SSL, 2FA) are adjacent controls and do not establish where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
